lines.zh: 我没有腿，只在地上滚着走。
lines.en: I've no legs; I roll along the ground.

lines.zh: 我被扔出去，落地就弹了两下。
lines.en: I'm thrown, land, and bounce twice.

lines.zh: 我一边滚一边发出声响。
lines.en: I make noise as I roll.

lines.zh: 我吸引所有人的目光，这就是我的活。
lines.en: I draw every eye. That's my job.

lines.zh: 我撞在石头上，拐了个弯。
lines.en: I hit a stone and veer off.
I don't steer. Wherever I'm thrown, I go.

lines.zh: 我滚过的路上，东西都停下看我。
lines.en: Whatever I pass stops to look at me.

lines.zh: 我不重，一只手就扔得动。
lines.en: I'm light enough to throw with one hand.

lines.zh: 我擦着地面，扬起一层灰。
lines.en: I scrape the ground and kick up dust.

lines.zh: 我滚进草里，又滚了出来。
lines.en: I roll into the grass and out again.

lines.zh: 我的动作很吵，我就是想吵。
lines.en: I'm noisy. Being noisy is the point.

lines.zh: 我最后停在一个显眼的地方。
lines.en: I stop at last somewhere conspicuous.

lines.zh: 我躺在那儿，谁都能看见。
lines.en: I lie there where anyone can see me.

lines.zh: 我不动，但周围的眼睛都转过来。
lines.en: I keep still, and every eye turns anyway.

lines.zh: 我身上有哥布林的记号。
lines.en: I bear a goblin's mark.
I'm waiting for the first blow.

lines.zh: 我只是一团吸引注意的东西。
lines.en: I'm just a lump of attention.
Wind nudges me and I wobble.

lines.zh: 我不疼，本来也不是活的。
lines.en: I don't feel pain. I was never alive.

lines.zh: 附近的东西都开始朝我转。
lines.en: The things nearby are turning toward me.

lines.zh: 我的影子很小，存在感很大。
lines.en: My shadow's small. My presence isn't.
I'm waiting to be torn apart.
You're looking at me. Good.
I'm here, so you should be looking over there.

lines.zh: 我的用处就是让你被忽略。
lines.en: My whole use is to make you overlooked.
Throw me. Throw me far.

lines.zh: 你手里抓着我的时候，我就在响。
lines.en: While you hold me, I'm already making noise.
Don't keep me. Use me.
I can buy you a little time.

lines.zh: 你后退，我在这儿继续闹。
lines.en: You step back. I'll keep making a fuss here.

lines.zh: 我认得你，你就是扔我的人。
lines.en: I know you. You're the one who threw me.

lines.zh: 我碎了也没关系，你走你的。
lines.en: Breaking doesn't matter. You just go.
I've got a dent.

lines.zh: 我的布条松了，声音变闷。
lines.en: My wrapping's loose and my noise is muffled.
I roll aside, still rattling.
Half torn open, but not yet apart.

lines.zh: 这点伤，我本来就不在乎。
lines.en: This sort of damage never bothered me.
My mark's been scored over.
I'm still here. They haven't left.
I've split, but I can still make noise.
I am crooked, but still standing.
Keep going. Don't look back.
The farther you throw, the longer I distract.
Throw me that way. More targets there.

lines.zh: 我滚到他们脚边就行了。
lines.en: Just get me rolling at their feet.
I'm not fussy. Conspicuous is enough.
You're winding up. I understand.
I'm ready. Throw.

lines.zh: 这一下要是扔偏了，就白费了。
lines.en: Miss the throw and I'm wasted.
I hear them coming.
Closer. Just a little closer.
Right. Off I go.
I hit something and roll further.

lines.zh: 我被踢开，正好换个位置。
lines.en: Someone kicks me, which is a change of position.
I bounce up and drop again.

lines.zh: 我的外壳已经凹了一块。
lines.en: My shell's already dented.
I roll to the wall and stop.

lines.zh: 撞我一下不疼，我本来就该挨。
lines.en: Bumping me doesn't hurt. I'm meant to be hit.
I've rolled back to your feet.
You step on me and I creak.
That noise drew them to me.
Fine. I'll stay here.

lines.zh: 我不是活的，谈不上这个。
lines.en: I'm not alive. It doesn't apply.
I exist only once.

lines.zh: 你要真舍不得，就多扔几次。
lines.en: If you're fond of me, throw me a few more times.

lines.zh: 这是我唯一能做好的事。
lines.en: This is the one thing I do well.

lines.zh: 我坏了，你还能再做一个。
lines.en: Break me and you can make another.
Don't grieve for me. I'm not worth it.

lines.zh: 被用完，就是我该有的结局。
lines.en: Being used up is the ending I'm meant for.
While I'm in one piece, I can still make noise.
Just remember that one throw.
Go on. Don't look back.
Picked up means about to be used.

lines.zh: 我在地上滚了半圈，等着。
lines.en: I rolled half a turn and wait.
I'm wrapped in cloth. Very light.
Could this be thrown too?

lines.zh: 我只是一团东西，捡不捡都行。
lines.en: I'm a lump of stuff. Pick me up or not.

lines.zh: 落在我旁边的东西，跟我无关。
lines.en: What lands beside me has nothing to do with me.
I'm waiting to be lifted.
I've rolled into a pile of things.

lines.zh: 我的记号还在，认得出来。
lines.en: My mark's still there. You can tell me apart.
Use me. Don't store me.
They've all turned their heads.

lines.zh: 我成了这地方唯一的焦点。
lines.en: I've become the only thing in focus here.

lines.zh: 第一个已经朝我走过来。
lines.en: The first one is already walking toward me.

lines.zh: 我听见爪子刮地的声音。
lines.en: I hear claws scraping the ground.
It feels like being called on.

lines.zh: 我成功了，他们全看我了。
lines.en: It worked. They're all watching me.
You need to move now.
It's getting crowded around me.

lines.zh: 我数着有多少个过来了。
lines.en: I'm counting how many are coming.
Come at me. Leave the others alone.

lines.zh: 我这点声音起了大作用。
lines.en: This little noise of mine did a lot.
I'm surrounded.

lines.zh: 他们不知道我只是个假的。
lines.en: They don't know I'm only a fake.
Look at me. Don't look over there.
There is still straw under the cloth.
Good. They're all coming at me.

lines.zh: 我在地上滚，他们跟着转。
lines.en: I roll and they turn with me.
Their eyes don't blink.
The louder I am, the closer they come.
I'm between you and them.
I'm nearly trampled flat.

lines.zh: 再坚持一下，你就走远了。
lines.en: A little longer and you'll be clear.

lines.zh: 他们的注意力全在我身上。
lines.en: All their attention is on me.
It's a racket around me.

lines.zh: 我看不见你了，被围住了。
lines.en: I can't see you now. They've closed in.
My noise is going hoarse.
Never mind me. Run.
They're still circling me.
If I can still move, I'm still useful.
My wrappings are coming loose.

lines.zh: 再过一会儿，我就撑不住了。
lines.en: A moment more and I'm done.

lines.zh: 我把他们全引到这一处。
lines.en: I'm drawing them all to this one spot.
Right now there's only me here.
I wasn't wasted.
Right. Time for me to come apart.
Go. Don't watch.
A claw rips me open.
Bitten, and I'm still rattling.

lines.zh: 他们打我，我要的就是这个。
lines.en: They're hitting me. That's exactly what I want.

lines.zh: 我这一下响得比刚才更大。
lines.en: That made an even louder noise.
I'm kicked into the air and come down.
They can see nothing but me.
The more I'm hit, the livelier it gets.
Half my wrappings are torn off.
They're crowding each other now.
This much use is enough.

lines.zh: 我快看不懂了，眼前全是爪。
lines.en: I can't follow it now. Nothing but claws.
A few more hits and I'll go silent.
I earned my keep.
Are you gone? I'd guess so.
They're still tearing at me. Funny.
I did everything I was for.
This time I made quite a fuss.
My noise is breaking up.
Right. That's it.
Thanks for throwing me so far.
I fly out of someone's hand.

lines.zh: 我落在离你不远的地方。
lines.en: I land not far from you.
The moment I land, I start rattling.

lines.zh: 这地方空旷，声音传得远。
lines.en: Open ground here. The sound carries.

lines.zh: 我被摔了一下，不过没事。
lines.en: I got thrown down. No harm.
Everything nearby lifts its head.
I know what I'm for.

lines.zh: 灰落在我身上，本来就脏。
lines.en: Dust settles on me. I was never clean.
I'm here. Look at me.
This time I'll be the loudest thing.
I roll twice and stop.
Good. All of you come on.

lines.zh: 布条烧起来，我成了个火团。
lines.en: My wrappings catch and I'm a ball of fire.

lines.zh: 我从高处摔下，散了几个零件。
lines.en: I fall from a height and lose a few pieces.

lines.zh: 水一灌，我的声音就没了。
lines.en: Water gets in and my noise stops.
The blast throws me far. Convenient.
The arrow goes through straw and into dirt.

lines.zh: 那力量压住我，我滚不动了。
lines.en: That force holds me down. I can't roll.

lines.zh: 放久了，我的布条也烂了。
lines.en: Left long enough, my wrappings rot.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我烧成了一团。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and I burn to a lump.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有地，我一直往下落。
lines.en: No ground in the void. I keep falling.
